usedFor: Edusign holds students, courses and professors, and Calendly receives a booking link through “Create Scheduling Link”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Student” in Edusign, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A new student can be handed a booking link as soon as they exist in Edusign.

watchOut: “New Student” in Edusign is polling, so the booking link follows the next scheduled check.
